# Aura Hair Collective

> Boutique hair salon in Carey Bay, Lake Macquarie, New South Wales. Specialists in lived-in blonde, balayage, foilayage, dimensional bronde, colour melts, cuts, blowouts and occasion styling.

## Location
- Shop 7/17 Laycock Street, Carey Bay NSW 2283, Australia
- Western shore of Lake Macquarie, with parking outside the salon door
- Phone: 0476 427 024
- Email: aurahaircollective@outlook.com

## Opening hours
- Tuesday: 10am–9pm (late night)
- Thursday: 10am–5pm
- Friday: 10am–4pm
- Saturday: by appointment request
- Sunday, Monday and Wednesday: closed
- Hours are indicative across chairs; live availability is shown on the booking calendar.

## Services
- Lived-in blonde, balayage and foilayage
- Dimensional bronde, root melts and tonal glossing
- Colour correction and seamless grow-out work
- Ladies and men's haircuts
- Blow dry, curls and occasion styling
- Bridal and event hair
- NAK Hair Professional and Blonde Duo salon care

## Booking
- Live appointments: https://www.makeonlinebooking.com/location/66147/hair-by-alora
- Or call 0476 427 024.
- For a colour change, bring inspiration and your recent colour history so the correct appointment length is reserved.

## Team
- Alora — salon owner and principal colourist, specialising in blonde, balayage and lived-in colour.
- Laura Dodds — founder of the original Carey Bay space, in the salon Thursdays and Fridays.
- Resident stylists include Tahlia and Danielle Mowatt.

## Areas served
Carey Bay, Coal Point, Fishing Point, Rathmines, Toronto, Lake Macquarie and Newcastle.

## Questions
- Where is Aura Hair Collective? Shop 7/17 Laycock Street, Carey Bay NSW 2283, with parking at the door.
- What are the hours? Tuesday 10am–9pm, Thursday 10am–5pm, Friday 10am–4pm; Saturday by request; closed Sunday, Monday and Wednesday.
- How do I book? Use the online calendar for live availability or call 0476 427 024.
- What services are offered? Lived-in blonde, balayage, foilayage, bronde, colour correction, cuts, blowouts and occasion styling.
- Is there parking? Yes, directly outside the salon.
